title: Retirement and education planning — three clients
instructions: Answer the questions about three unrelated clients in 2025.

exhibits.title: Client 1 — Kara (single, age 45)
exhibits.content:
- Covered by her employer's 401(k)
- MAGI: **$85,000**
- Contributed **$7,000** to a traditional IRA

exhibits.title: Client 2 — Leo (age 50)
exhibits.content:
- Withdrew **$20,000** from his traditional IRA (all pre-tax) in 2025
- AGI, including the distribution: **$120,000**
- Unreimbursed medical expenses paid in 2025: **$12,000**
- No other exception applies

exhibits.title: Client 3 — the Nguyens
exhibits.content:
- A §529 plan distributed **$15,000**, of which **$6,000** is earnings
- Qualified higher education expenses paid: **$9,000**
- No education credits claimed

rows.label: Leo's medical expense exception to the 10% additional tax
Could Kara contribute to a Roth IRA instead?
options: Yes — her MAGI is below the Roth phase-out
No — her MAGI is too high
rows.answer: Yes — her MAGI is below the Roth phase-out
rows.explanation: Roth limits don't depend on plan coverage.
